The '''doo''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Common in [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] near the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], home to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], doo were a [[Diet/Legends|dietary]] staple both of Gungan recipes and [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. The doo ranged in [[Color/Legends|color]] from a dull yellow to a tan or gray hue.

==Description==
[[File:Doofish.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Various perspectives showing the doo from front, side, and top]]
Doo were large, broad-sided [[Scalefish/Legends|scalefish]] that possessed pectoral fins behind the head, small dorsal fins along the back, and a large caudal fin at the rear to propel them through the [[Water/Legends|water]], as well as small feelers or sense organs along the bottom of the body. They also displayed sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] set within a formidable set of jaws, and [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] recessed from their outer cartilage. Skin color ranged from dull yellow to tan and gray.<ref name="CSWE" /> As the doo was very common to [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] on the<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], it was a [[Diet/Legends|dietary]] staple of both [[Human/Legends|Humans]], known as the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], and the aquatic [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]].<ref name="SWCTP" /> The fish was attracted by the lights of the underwater Gungan [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] but knew by experience to stay away from the [[gelatin]]ous substance that led to the city's air-filled chambers.<ref name="EVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==History==
The doo evolved in the deep waters of the planet Naboo.<ref name="CSWE" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> while escaping invading forces of a megacorporation called the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]; his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; and the Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] swam by a number of doo on their way to [[Lake]] Paonga's underwater Gungan city of Otoh Gunga to talk with Gungan representatives.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The doo, along with fellow scalefish [[Ray/Legends|ray]], [[Mee/Legends|mee]], [[Faa/Legends|faa]], [[See/Legends|see]], [[Laa/Legends|laa]], and [[Tee/Legends|tee]], appear to reference the real-world [[Wikipedia:Solfège|musical scale]]; i.e, "Do, Re, Me, Fa, So, La, Ti, Do." The [[Fish/Legends|fish]] made its first appearance in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> and was described in the reference guide ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', where it received its name.<ref name="SWCTP" />
